_why: TYPE ANNOTATIONS THAT PROMOTION CANNOT CARRY, applied by promote-screen.py
after it transforms a screen. Studio source is JSX, the app is TypeScript,
so every promoted page loses its parameter types the moment it is
re-promoted. Before this file they were reapplied BY HAND: ten of them on
12 Aug 2026 alone, twice over, because a renumber re-promoted eleven
screens in one pass. That is a chore that gets skipped, and a skipped one
EACH ENTRY IS EXACT-STRING, and promote-screen.py FAILS if a `find` does
not appear exactly once. That is deliberate: a patch that silently stops
matching is worse than a loud error, because the annotation quietly
disappears and tsc breaks somewhere unrelated. If a patch fails, the
Studio source moved: read the new source, update the string here.
KEEP THESE MINIMAL. A patch is for something TypeScript needs and JSX
cannot express. Anything else belongs in the Studio source, where both

STALE PATCHES ARE THE FAILURE MODE, and one showed up the same day this file was written: the bank-accounts entry annotated a BankMark and an AccountRows that had already moved into the AccountDetails shared component, so the screen no longer declared either. The loud failure did its job (the promotion refused rather than dropping an annotation) and the entry was deleted. When a patch stops matching, first check whether the thing it types still exists here at all.
